storage.writes: Server validates sender and recipient/current guild, allocates ID and time, encrypts, commits atomically, then delivers. Failed persistence prevents delivery.
storage.timestamp: created_at DATETIME(3), UTC. Exact epoch milliseconds reconstructed for existing authenticated metadata and managed wire.

protection.key_storage: Dedicated ACL-protected directory outside the repository, server package, HTTP content root and database; key material never sent to clients or logged.
protection.key_acl: Verified: server Windows identity and SYSTEM only.
protection.message_update_delete: Rejected by append-only database triggers; no client editing or deletion API.
protection.access: Private scope always includes authenticated player ID. Guild scope comes from live server identity and is checked against current SQL membership. Cursors must reference a row in that exact authorized scope.
protection.queries: Bound prepared values with strict bounded identifiers, numeric cursors, limits and throttles.
protection.read_integrity: Decrypt/authenticate every row in a page before sending any content. Authentication failure rejects the page and exposes no unverified body.
protection.plain_copies: Private/guild legacy GM chat logging suppressed while archive enabled. Offline messages bypass the former plaintext offline queue. History command payloads excluded from debug command logging.

limits_and_untested: Archive starts when enabled; volatile client-only history from before activation is not imported as authentic server data.
Normal public/shout chat and the separate system-broadcast notification feed are outside this Social archive.
Message bodies are encrypted; routing metadata and read cursors are not hidden from database administrators.

Full database/server administrators can bypass triggers, delete data or restore an older valid database. No external WORM storage or independent rollback anchor is implemented. A compromised server/key holder is outside this protection boundary.
Keep the encryption key backed up separately; replacing or losing it prevents decryption of existing rows. No automatic key rotation is introduced.
Current integration uses one player database/character-ID namespace; independently numbered realms require separate player databases.
Cross-core live delivery, production load, standalone player build, physical Android/iOS devices and an independent security audit were not exercised in this work unit.
local_server: Running all channels plus CH99 with encrypted history enabled; existing content service preserved.
version_control: Local changes only; no commit, check-in or push.
